dataset_name: Airport Investment Intelligence illustrative MVP fixtures
disclaimer: All passenger, seat, departure, delay, taxi, cancellation, runway-use, and route-volume values are synthetic demonstration values. They are not official FAA or BTS observations and must not be used for investment decisions.

notes: Airport codes, names, cities, and states identify the supported MVP airports.
Runway counts are synthetic analytical inputs for the demonstration.
Passenger and seat totals are synthetic annual values.
Previous-period passenger totals are synthetic values used for deterministic growth calculations.
The rows form the complete synthetic performed-departure universe used by the MVP long-haul calculation.
For every supported airport, route departures sum exactly to operations performed departures.
Distances and route volumes are demonstration inputs, not published measurements.
Departure, delay, taxi-out, cancellation, and runway-use values are synthetic.
Scheduled departures equal performed departures plus reported cancellations.
Performed departures equal the complete route-fixture denominator for each airport.
